mapper.sql: SELECT e.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, fb.version AS from_version, tb.version AS to_version, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM mes_ecn e LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = e.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_bom fb ON fb.id = e.from_bom_id LEFT JOIN mes_bom tb ON tb.id = e.to_bom_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mes_ecn WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND effective_date <= #{today} ORDER BY effective_date, id
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_ecn SET status = #{to}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
